chose: project agent hooks invoke the checked-out TypeScript CLI for SessionStart, SubagentStart, Stop, and SubagentStop

dist/cli.js, which does not exist before the first build

chose: self-host coherence as four ownership components: repository surface, harness core, adapters, and executable contracts

one spec per source file, which mistakes files for architectural boundaries

omit self-verification because verify has no read-only flag
because: docs --check is non-mutating by contract; verify is meaningful only if it runs, and an archived snapshot lets it exercise the real specs and source while confining its status write outside the checkout

commit specs but leave the first reader with the old empty map

over: collect traces without testing that their schema and calibration remain usable
run the mutating signal recorder in CI
because: a non-mutating check belongs beside tests and artifact freshness: it proves the per-change signal mechanism is structurally live without fabricating CI read observations

chose: observe explicit repository reads through a PostToolUse hook matched to Read, Grep, and Glob
over: observe every tool use, which turns unrelated writes and shell work into false read-cost evidence
infer reads from the final patch, which cannot reveal context acquired and discarded
because: per-change calibration needs the actual read-bearing events; a narrow matcher makes that signal cheap enough to collect while lifecycle hooks preserve the decisions those reads informed

chose: anchor the five new self-hosting obligations in the Harness core spec at runHook, signal, contextFor, auditPremiseLeases, and calibrate

chose: CI checks that every self-hosted invariant has keyed rationale
